sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** Under this scheme, motorized tricycles are provided to specially-abled individuals with 50% or more locomotor disability to support self-employment and pursuing higher education from Senior Higher Secondary onwards.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Skills & Employment

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Motorized Tricycle Yojana&quot; is a scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, motorized tricycles are provided to eligible applicants for purposes such as self-employment and pursuing higher education from Senior Higher Secondary onwards. To be eligible for the scheme, the applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan, a specially-abled person with 50% or more locomotor disability, and possess driving experience along with a valid driving license.
**Benefits / Assistance:** Under this scheme, beneficiaries will receive a motorized tricycle free of cost to support self-employment and higher education from the Senior Secondary level onwards.

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Social Justice &amp; Empowerment Department and request a copy of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Social Justice &amp; Empowerment Department. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Social Justice &amp; Empowerment Department to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Persons With Disabilities, Motorized Tricycle, Locomotor Disability, Self-employment, PwD
